    # Priya Nair, Inspection Manager at NorthGrid Energy

    # Who you're meeting

    Priya Nair, inspection manager at NorthGrid Energy. Owns the
    winter-inspection decision; reports to their COO. Direct,
    safety-focused, short on time.

    # Where things stand

    Piloting Atlas since spring across 3 substations. Flagged
    false-positive thermal alerts as the blocker before winter.
    Expansion decision this quarter.

    # Recent history

    Last touchpoint was a support thread on report exports, resolved in
    two days. Their field crews rated the pilot highly.
